【Major features】
★ Powerful Dictionary: rich examples including chars, words, sentences, character decomposition, etymology, calligraphy...

★ Rich Courses: standard HSK courses, video course, podcast courses, spoken courses...

★ Writing & Pronunication practice: specialized training for the hardest part of Chinese
 
★ Oral practice with AI: practice with your favourite virtual charcter

★ HSK Proficiency Test: take a mock test, save you a lot

★ Practical Tools: pinyin news, flashcards, Chinese to pinyin, Chinese converter, chat classroom, more appendices...

Get it now! Join our Telegram group if you have any questions: https://t.me/+-HAJP76ube05NzJl
